title: No charges in DPS killing of Dion Johnson
summary: County Attorney Allister Adel declined to charge the DPS trooper who shot and killed Dion Johnson on May 25, 2020.

title: Protest 'gang' prosecution
summary: MCAO prosecutor April Sponsel brought criminal street gang charges against 18 people arrested at a downtown Phoenix protest.

title: Judge finds 'egregious misconduct' in protest case
summary: A Superior Court judge dismissed the gang charges with prejudice and found the lead prosecutor and a Phoenix police sergeant colluded to present false information to the grand jury.

sources.label: ABC15 – MCAO to dismiss all charges

title: County Attorney Allister Adel resigns
summary: Adel announced her resignation, effective March 25, 2022.

title: Rachel Mitchell appointed County Attorney
summary: The Board of Supervisors unanimously appointed veteran prosecutor Rachel Mitchell to serve until a special election.
